name: Austroposeidon
sum: Austroposeidon is a giant titanosaur from the Presidente Prudente Formation of Brazil, the largest dinosaur found there.
wsnote: About 25 m long for the single adult specimen (Wikipedia revision).
holotype: A single specimen with vertebrae, described in 2016.
biology: No biological statement was read in the sources consulted.
author: Bandeira et al. 2016
